layout: Screen-fixed behind everything (it does not scroll), then washed 35% toward the altitude colour by code. Code draws the sun/moon, parallax clouds, hot-air balloons and twinkles on top. Keep the top ~120 px and the right 140 px calm (HUD chips and the height track)
description: A soft, dreamy open sky with no ground and no horizon: a gentle pastel gradient (light blue at the top to pale pink-peach at the bottom) with a few very faint, wispy far-away clouds and tiny pale sparkles. Low contrast and low detail so foreground clouds and characters read clearly

layout: Game-select shelf and how-to screen, drawn with `cover` fit (procedural `drawIcon` is the fallback)
description: A cheerful character bouncing high off a fluffy white cloud with motion lines, a stack of clouds climbing up the picture (a pink springy cloud, a grey sleepy rain cloud, a trampoline), a glowing gold star, and a big rainbow arch with a gold star on top at the summit, against a sunset-pink-to-lavender sky. Subject centred

layout: A normal cloud platform, stretched (not aspect-kept) into a box (platform width + 20) × (≈96 px) for widths 160–250 px. The landing line (where feet touch) is about 16% down from the top edge of the image; the puffy bumps rise slightly above it, the rounded body hangs below
description: A fluffy white cartoon cloud seen from the side: a row of round puffs on top, a soft rounded underside with pale periwinkle cel shading, navy outline, a small highlight on the top-left puffs. Optional tiny happy closed-eye face with pink cheeks on the lower body. Wide and fairly flat (about 2.6:1)

layout: Same box and landing line as `prop/cloudhop-cloud`. The super-bouncy cloud (launches you very high)
description: The same cloud shape in bubblegum pink with deeper pink shading, a surprised "ooh" face, little gold coil springs peeking out underneath, and a white sparkle. Looks bouncy and fun

layout: Same box and landing line as `prop/cloudhop-cloud`. Puffs away after one bounce (code fades/scales it and adds drops)
description: The same cloud shape in soft blue-grey, with a sleepy, content closed-eye face (not grumpy, not scary), two or three tiny light-blue raindrops dangling underneath

layout: Same box and landing line as `prop/cloudhop-cloud`. Slides left and right (code adds wind swooshes)
description: The same cloud shape in pale lavender with white highlights and a couple of tiny curly wind swirls on its sides

layout: Bottom-centre anchored 70 px below the landing line, fitted (aspect kept) into (≈190)×100 px. The top of the trampoline mat is 30% down from the top edge
description: A small round party trampoline on a little white cloud: a pink-and-white striped stretchy mat, yellow ball rims at the ends, short sky-blue legs, side view

layout: A wide rainbow bridge platform, stretched into 720×140 px centred 40 px below the landing line. The landing line is 21% down from the top edge, flat across
description: A short, gently sagging rainbow-striped bridge (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple bands) with a navy outline and a white shine stripe, resting on a fluffy white cloud puff at each end. Side view, flat top

layout: Collectible star, drawn centred and fitted into 72×72 px (code adds a soft glow and a gentle wobble)
description: A chubby glossy gold five-point star with rounded tips, navy outline, a white shine on the upper left. Optional tiny happy face

layout: The rescue bubble that floats a fallen player back up, drawn centred over the character and fitted to ≈2.1 × the bubble radius (≈ 150–220 px). The character must show through it
description: A big round soap bubble: mostly transparent centre, an iridescent pink-blue-lilac rim, a white curved highlight at the upper left, a thin white outline

layout: The goal, bottom-centre anchored 60 px below the summit landing line and fitted into 1640×520; the code draws a full-width golden cloud bank over the bottom ~70 px
description: A huge, glowing rainbow arch (seven bands with a navy outline and a white shimmer) spanning almost the full width, with a big chubby gold star on top at the centre and golden sparkles around. No ground: the arch feet are hidden by clouds drawn in code

layout: Background decoration, centred and fitted into ≈ 75–110 × 100–155 px, drawn at 85% opacity drifting slowly
description: A cute hot-air balloon with candy stripes (pink and white), a little woven basket on ropes, navy outline, soft shading. Empty basket
